entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard on I.A. No.6230/2023, which is first application filed on behalf of the appellant for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

The appellant has been convicted by the trial Court under Section 376(2)
(l) of I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.5000/-, with default stipulation.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the appellant for aforesaid offence.
Appellant has already served jail sentence about four years.
The appellant is in jail since long and there is a bleak possibility of disposal of this appeal in near future,
therefore, the custodial sentence of the appellant may be suspended and he may be released on bail.
Learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the application.

Although, case is not supported by the medical evidence, but on the basis of the statement of the prosecutrix, who was minor aged about 12 years,
the trial Court convicted the appellant.
After considering the aforesaid facts and evidence available on record, this Court is not inclined to allow this application at this juncture.
Accordingly, I.A. No.6230/2023 is hereby dismissed.

(SMT. ANJULI PALO) JUDGE rj Rajendra Khairwar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182918429/
